name: go-faster/bot
note: Root atlas.hcl with an ent:// source and a hashed migration directory. The ent source and the docker:// dev database are out of the offline command set, so this tier measures only what needs neither.

name: chainloop-dev/chainloop
note: A control plane whose atlas.hcl sits under app/controlplane rather than at the root, with 141 files in its hashed migration directory -- an order of magnitude more than the first repository, which is what makes it worth pinning.

name: diggerhq/digger
note: The first non-Apache repository in this tier, and the first whose migration directory is a plain backend/migrations rather than one an ORM generates.
